verdict.rationale: Context.dev supports watching a page/sitemap/dataset on a schedule and emitting signed change events (webhooks), which is a basic event-trigger mechanism, but there's no evidence of a broader rule engine allowing conditional logic or custom automated actions beyond notification. Missing for 10: documented conditional/rule syntax, ability to chain custom actions (not just webhook delivery), and evidence of integration with automation platforms (e.g. Zapier) to complete the 'trigger actions' loop.
